questions.prompt: Do you always carry a lot of keys with you?
questions.sampleA1: I have one key. It is for my house. I always have it.
questions.sampleA2: I have two keys. One is for my home, and one is for my bike. I always carry them with me because I need them.
questions.sampleB1: Yes, I usually carry some keys with me. I have a key for my house, and another for my office. For example, I need the house key to get in after work. However, I try not to carry too many keys because they can be heavy and annoying in my pocket. I also have a small keychain.
questions.sampleB2: To be honest, no, I don't. I used to lug around this massive bunch of keys, but I've pared it down to just two — my flat and my bike lock. The thing is, a bulky keyring is such a nuisance in your pocket. I suppose I'm slowly moving over to keyless entry, which is far more convenient.
questions.uzSampleA1: Menda bitta kalit bor. U mening uyim uchun. Menda u doim bor.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menda ikkita kalit bor. Bittasi uyim uchun, bittasi esa velosipedim uchun. Men ularni doim o'zim bilan olib yuraman, chunki ular menga kerak.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Ha, men odatda o'zim bilan bir nechta kalit olib yuraman. Mening uyimning kaliti bor va yana ofisimning kaliti bor.
Masalan, ishdan keyin kirish uchun menga uyning kaliti kerak.
Biroq, men juda ko'p kalit olib yurmaslikka harakat qilaman, chunki ular cho'ntagimda og'ir va bezovta qilishi mumkin. Menda kichik kalitlar bog'lami ham bor.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Men odatda o'zim bilan bir nechta kalit olib yuraman, ha. Mening kvartiram, ofisim va pochta qutim uchun kalitlarim bor.
Aslida, men o'zim bilan olib yuradigan kalitlar sonini kamaytirishga harakat qildim, shuning uchun men muntazam ravishda ishlatmaydigan har qanday kalitdan qutuldim.
Bundan tashqari, katta kalit halqasi juda noqulay bo'lishi mumkin. Men ko'proq narsalarga kalit kartalari yoki telefon ilovalari orqali kirish mumkin bo'lishini xohlardim.

vocabulary.title: Do you - First words of prompt...

questions.sampleAnswer:
Actually, I don't carry many keys at all anymore. I've pared down my keyring to just the essentials: my house key and a key for my bicycle lock. To be honest, I'm trying to move towards keyless entry systems where possible; it's just so much more convenient and reduces the risk of losing a whole bunch of keys. I think physical keys are gradually becoming a thing of the past.

The fewer things I need to carry, the better, really. I find it incredibly liberating to not have to fuss around with a bulky keyring. I am considering upgrading my front door to one with a fingerprint scanner. Less is more, as they say, and that definitely applies to what I carry around daily.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Aslida, men hozir umuman ko'p kalit olib yurmayman. Men kalitlarimni faqat eng zarur narsalargacha qisqartirdim: uyimning kaliti va velosiped qulfimning kaliti. Rostini aytsam, men imkon qadar kalitsiz kirish tizimlariga o'tishga harakat qilyapman; bu shunchaki ancha qulay va bir dasta kalitni yo'qotish xavfini kamaytiradi. O'ylashimcha, jismoniy kalitlar asta-sekin o'tmishga aylanib bormoqda.

Qanchalik kam narsa olib yurishim kerak bo'lsa, shunchalik yaxshi, rosti. Men katta kalitlar bilan ovora bo'lishimga hojat yo'qligi meni juda ozod qiladi. Men old eshigimni barmoq izi skaneri bilan jihozlashni o'ylayapman. Aytishlaricha, "oz ko'pdir", va bu, albatta, har kuni olib yuradigan narsalarimga tegishli.

questions.prompt: When was the last time you bought a pen or a pencil?
questions.sampleA1: I bought a pen. It was black. I use it at school.
questions.sampleA2: I bought a pencil last week. I needed it for drawing. It was cheap, and I liked it.
questions.sampleB1: The last time I bought a pen was maybe last year. I needed it to sign some documents. For example, I had to sign a contract. However, I usually use my computer for writing. I don't buy pens very often.
questions.sampleB2: Let me think... it must have been a couple of months ago, actually. I picked up a nice fountain pen because I'd got into calligraphy. Other than that, I hardly ever buy stationery these days — I tend to do everything on my laptop. I guess pens are gradually falling out of use.

questions.uzSampleA2: Men o'tgan hafta qalam sotib oldim. Menga u rasm chizish uchun kerak edi. U arzon edi va menga yoqdi.
questions.uzSampleB1: Oxirgi marta ruchka sotib olganim o'tgan yili bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin. Menga uni ba'zi hujjatlarga imzo chekish uchun kerak bo'ldi. Masalan, men shartnomaga imzo chekishim kerak edi. Biroq, men odatda yozish uchun kompyuterimdan foydalanaman. Men ruchkalarni unchalik tez-tez sotib olmayman.
questions.uzSampleB2: Agar xotiram pand bermasa, oxirgi marta ruchka yoki qalam sotib olganimga bir necha oy bo'lgan bo'lsa kerak. Menga xattotlik mashqlari uchun maxsus turdagi ruchka kerak edi. Aniqrog'i, bu ingichka uchli favvora ruchkasi edi. Aks holda, men asosan raqamli vositalardan foydalanganim uchun, kanselyariya buyumlarini zaxiraga to'ldirmayman.

questions.sampleAnswer:
Let me think... The last time I bought a pen or pencil was probably a couple of months ago. I needed a set of colored pencils for a project I was working on; it involved some detailed diagrams and I wanted to make them visually appealing. I'm not much of a stationery addict, though. I tend to use digital tools for most of my writing and drawing needs.

As a matter of fact, I find myself buying pens and pencils less and less frequently. Everything is digital now; even taking notes in meetings is done on a tablet. Indeed, physical writing implements seem almost quaint in this day and age. It's a sign of the times, I suppose!
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
O'ylab ko'raychi... Qalam yoki ruchka oxirgi marta sotib olganimga bir necha oy bo'lgan bo'lsa kerak. Menga bir loyiha uchun rangli qalamlar to'plami kerak edi; u ba'zi batafsil diagrammalarni o'z ichiga olgan va men ularni vizual jihatdan jozibali qilmoqchi edim. Garchi men katta qog'oz-qalam ishqiboz emasman. Men yozish va chizish ehtiyojlarimning ko'pchiligi uchun raqamli vositalardan foydalanishga moyilman.

Aslida, men o'zimni qalam va ruchkalarni tobora kamroq sotib olayotganimni sezaman. Hozir hamma narsa raqamli; hatto yig'ilishlarda qaydlar olish ham planshetda amalga oshiriladi. Haqiqatan ham, jismoniy yozuv qurollari hozirgi kunda deyarli eski tuyuladi. Bu zamonning belgisi, deb o'ylayman!

Men ko'proq yapon taomlarini yaxshi ko'raman.

questions.sampleAnswer:
That's a tricky question, as there are so many incredible cuisines around the world! However, if I had to pick just one, I'd probably say Italian food. It hits all the right notes for me: the simplicity of the ingredients, the incredible variety of dishes, and the sheer passion that goes into preparing it.

From the rustic charm of a simple pasta dish to the sophistication of a perfectly executed risotto, Italian cuisine offers something for everyone. Moreover, I appreciate the emphasis on fresh, seasonal ingredients. It just ticks all the boxes. Plus, who can resist a good pizza or a scoop of gelato?
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Bu qiyin savol, chunki dunyoda juda ko'p ajoyib oshxonalar bor! Biroq, agar men faqat bittasini tanlashim kerak bo'lsa, men italyan taomlarini tanlagan bo'lardim. Bu men uchun hamma jihatdan to'g'ri keladi: ingredientlarning soddaligi, taomlarning ajoyib xilma-xilligi va uni tayyorlashga sarflanadigan katta ishtiyoq.

Oddiy makaron taomining qishloqona jozibasidan tortib, mukammal tarzda tayyorlangan rizottoning nafisligigacha, italyan oshxonasi har kim uchun nimadir taklif qiladi. Bundan tashqari, men yangi, mavsumiy ingredientlarga e'tibor qaratilishini qadrlayman. Bu shunchaki hamma talablarga javob beradi. Qolaversa, kim yaxshi pizza yoki bir qoshiq gelatoga qarshi tura oladi?

questions.prompt: What do you see in these pictures?
questions.sampleA1: The first picture has a computer. The second picture has a painter. The painter has paint.
questions.sampleA2: One picture has a computer. The other picture has an artist. The computer makes art, but the artist paints with hands.
questions.sampleB1: In the first picture, I see someone using a computer to make art. In the second picture, I see an artist painting. For example, the artist is using a paintbrush. However, the computer uses AI. Both pictures show people creating art, but in different ways. It's interesting to compare them.
questions.sampleB2: So in the first picture, there's a woman sitting at her desk typing a prompt into her laptop, and on the big monitor next to her, the AI has churned out this stunning mountain landscape — snowy peaks, a river and a little cabin. In the second one, though, there's an artist standing at an easel, absolutely covered in paint, working on a colourful abstract canvas by hand. The contrast really jumps out at me: one relies on technology to do the heavy lifting, while the other is all about human skill and getting your hands dirty.

Oxir oqibat, ikkalasi ham ijodkorlik shakllarini ifodalaydi, garchi jarayonlar juda farqli bo'lsa ham.

questions.sampleAnswer:
In the first image, I see a person typing something into a computer, and on the screen, there's what appears to be an incredibly detailed and realistic painting. Clearly, it's depicting the use of AI to generate art from a text prompt. The second image shows a traditional artist, covered in paint, working intensely on a canvas. The contrast is striking.

The images bring to the fore the debate around AI and art. On one hand, you have the speed and efficiency of AI, capable of producing stunning visuals in seconds. On the other hand, there's the human element, the years of practice, the emotional investment, and the tangible connection between the artist and their work. Both methods have their merits. The future of art is uncertain, though. It will be interesting to see how these two worlds play out.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Birinchi rasmda men kompyuterga nimadir yozayotgan odamni ko'ryapman va ekranda juda batafsil va realistik rasmga o'xshagan narsa bor. Shubhasiz, bu matnli so'rovdan san'at yaratish uchun sun'iy intellektdan foydalanishni tasvirlaydi. Ikkinchi rasmda bo'yoqqa botgan, tuval ustida qattiq ishlayotgan an'anaviy rassom ko'rsatilgan. Zidiyat juda sezilarli.

Rasmlar sun'iy intellekt va san'at atrofidagi bahsni oldinga olib chiqadi. Bir tomonda, sizda sun'iy intellektning tezligi va samaradorligi bor, u soniyalarda hayratlanarli vizual tasvirlarni yaratishga qodir. Boshqa tomondan, inson omili, ko'p yillik mashqlar, hissiy sarmoya va rassom bilan uning ishi o'rtasidagi aniq aloqa mavjud. Ikkala usul ham o'z afzalliklariga ega. San'atning kelajagi noaniq, garchi. Bu ikki dunyo qanday rivojlanishini ko'rish qiziqarli bo'ladi.

questions.prompt: What are some of the advantages of using AI to create art or designs?
questions.sampleA1: AI is fast. AI makes many pictures. AI is good.
questions.sampleA2: AI can make art quickly. It can make many different styles. Also, AI is easy to use.
questions.sampleB1: AI has some advantages for art. It can create art very fast. For example, it can make many versions of a picture. This helps people explore new ideas. However, some people think it is not real art.
questions.sampleB2: Well, the biggest plus is speed, without a doubt. AI can knock out dozens of variations in seconds, which is great for bouncing around ideas. On top of that, it lowers the barrier to entry — you don't need years of training to bring an idea to life. It also throws up styles a person might never have dreamt up on their own.
questions.uzSampleA1: Sun'iy intellekt tez. Sun'iy intellekt ko'p rasmlar yaratadi. Sun'iy intellekt yaxshi.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Sun'iy intellekt san'atni tez yaratishi mumkin. U ko'plab turli uslublarni yaratishi mumkin.
Shuningdek, sun'iy intellektdan foydalanish oson.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Sun'iy intellektning san'at uchun ba'zi afzalliklari bor. U san'atni juda tez yaratishi mumkin.
Masalan, u rasmning ko'plab versiyalarini yaratishi mumkin. Bu odamlarga yangi g'oyalarni o'rganishga yordam beradi.
Biroq, ba'zi odamlar bu haqiqiy san'at emas deb o'ylashadi.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Sun'iy intellekt san'at yaratishda bir qancha afzalliklarni taqdim etadi. U san'at asarlarini yaratish uchun zarur bo'lgan vaqtni keskin qisqartiradi va tezkor tajriba o'tkazish imkonini beradi.
Bundan tashqari, sun'iy intellekt tendentsiyalarni aniqlash va yangi dizaynlarni yaratish uchun katta hajmdagi ma'lumotlarni tahlil qilishi mumkin. Bu odamlar uchun tushunish qiyin bo'lgan uslublarni o'rganish imkonini beradi.
Bundan tashqari, sun'iy intellekt vositalari tobora ommabop bo'lib bormoqda, bu esa shaxsning badiiy tajribasidan qat'i nazar, san'at yaratish imkoniyatini beradi.

vocabulary.title: What are - First words of prompt...
sentenceStarters: "The main benefit is..." - "Asosiy foyda shuki..." - "Asosiy foyda shuki..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Well, undoubtedly, AI offers a plethora of advantages in art and design. The speed at which AI can generate iterations is unparalleled; it can churn out countless variations on a theme in a fraction of the time it would take a human artist. This allows for rapid prototyping and exploration of ideas that might otherwise be too time-consuming to pursue.

Furthermore, AI can often uncover novel aesthetics or combinations that a human might not conceive of independently. It can analyze vast datasets of existing art and design, identifying patterns and trends that can then be synthesized into something new. It's like having a tireless collaborator who is always ready to experiment, pushing the boundaries of creative expression. Indeed, the accessibility of AI tools democratizes art creation, allowing individuals with limited traditional artistic skills to bring their visions to life.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Xo'sh, shubhasiz, sun'iy intellekt san'at va dizaynda ko'plab afzalliklarni taqdim etadi. Sun'iy intellektning iteratsiyalarni yaratish tezligi beqiyos; u inson rassomiga ketadigan vaqtning bir qismida mavzu bo'yicha son-sanoqsiz variantlarni yaratishi mumkin. Bu tez prototiplash va boshqa hollarda amalga oshirish uchun juda ko'p vaqt talab qiladigan g'oyalarni o'rganish imkonini beradi.

Bundan tashqari, sun'iy intellekt ko'pincha inson mustaqil ravishda o'ylab topa olmaydigan yangi estetikalar yoki kombinatsiyalarni ochib berishi mumkin. U mavjud san'at va dizaynning katta ma'lumotlar to'plamlarini tahlil qilib, keyin yangi narsaga sintez qilinishi mumkin bo'lgan naqsh va tendentsiyalarni aniqlay oladi. Bu tinimsiz hamkorga ega bo'lishga o'xshaydi, u doimo tajriba o'tkazishga, ijodiy ifoda chegaralarini kengaytirishga tayyor. Haqiqatan ham, sun'iy intellekt vositalarining qulayligi san'at yaratishni demokratlashtiradi va an'anaviy badiiy ko'nikmalari cheklangan shaxslarga o'z tasavvurlarini hayotga tatbiq etish imkonini beradi.

questions.sampleB2: I think it mainly comes down to the human touch. When someone knows a real person poured hours of skill and emotion into a piece, it feels far more authentic. vocabulary.title: Why do - First words of prompt...
idioms: a labor of love - "mehr bilan qilingan ish"

questions.sampleAnswer:
Many people cherish handmade art for its inherent human touch and authenticity. There's a sense of connection with the artist, knowing that a real person poured their time, skill, and emotion into the piece. Indeed, handmade art often carries imperfections that machine-made art lacks, and these imperfections are precisely what make it unique and appealing. It stands to reason that these imperfections showcase the artist's skill and the hands-on process involved.

Furthermore, handmade art often supports individual artists and small businesses, fostering a sense of community and preserving traditional crafts. It's a way of valuing human creativity and craftsmanship over mass production and technological efficiency. People appreciate the story behind the art, especially if they know the artist. For some, it's about investing in something unique and meaningful, a piece that reflects their values and personality.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Ko'p odamlar qo'lda yasalgan san'atni o'ziga xos insoniy teginishi va haqiqiyligi uchun qadrlashadi. Rassom bilan aloqa hissi bor, haqiqiy inson o'z vaqtini, mahoratini va his-tuyg'ularini asarga bag'ishlaganini bilish. Haqiqatan ham, qo'lda yasalgan san'atda ko'pincha mashina tomonidan yaratilgan san'atda bo'lmagan kamchiliklar mavjud va aynan shu kamchiliklar uni noyob va jozibali qiladi. Shu sababli, bu kamchiliklar rassomning mahoratini va qo'lda bajarilgan jarayonni namoyish etadi.

Bundan tashqari, qo'lda yasalgan san'at ko'pincha individual rassomlarni va kichik biznesni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, hamjamiyat tuyg'usini rivojlantiradi va an'anaviy hunarmandchilikni saqlab qoladi. Bu ommaviy ishlab chiqarish va texnologik samaradorlikdan ko'ra inson ijodkorligi va hunarmandchiligini qadrlash usuli. Odamlar san'at ortidagi hikoyani qadrlashadi, ayniqsa agar ular rassomni tanishsa. Ba'zilar uchun bu noyob va mazmunli narsaga, ularning qadriyatlari va shaxsiyatini aks ettiruvchi asarga sarmoya kiritish demakdir.

questions.prompt: Describe a time you taught a friend a technique to stay calm or reduce stress.
questions.sampleA1: I taught my friend to be calm. She was stressed. I helped her.
questions.sampleA2: My friend was stressed, so I taught her to breathe. It helped her. I learned about stress too.
questions.sampleB1: My friend was very stressed, so I showed her how to breathe deeply. She felt better. This helped me understand my own stress. For example, I learned that I also need to relax. Emotional intelligence is important. However, school is also important.
questions.sampleB2: Right, so I'd like to talk about a time I helped my friend Dilnoza, who was completely stressed out during her final exams. She was snowed under with revision, barely sleeping, and honestly on the verge of a breakdown. So I sat her down and walked her through a simple breathing technique I'd picked up — you basically breathe in for four counts, hold, and breathe out slowly, letting your thoughts drift past without clinging to them. Within a few minutes she'd calmed right down, and she ended up using it before every exam. The interesting thing is, helping her actually taught me a lot about myself. Watching her wrestle with anxiety made me far more aware of my own stress triggers, and I realised I'd been bottling things up for years. The thing is, once you learn to read someone else's emotions, you start noticing your own patterns too. I suppose you can't really support someone unless you've done a bit of soul-searching yourself. As for whether emotional intelligence matters more than grades — honestly, I'd say it does, in the long run. Good marks might get your foot in the door, but it's your ability to read a room, stay level-headed under pressure and get along with people that carries you through life. At the end of the day, you can be the smartest person in the office, but if you can't handle your own feelings or connect with others, you'll struggle. So all in all, I genuinely believe emotional intelligence is worth its weight in gold.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men do'stimga xotirjam bo'lishni o'rgatdim. U stressda edi. Men unga yordam berdim.

Umuman olganda, hissiy intellekt hayotda muvaffaqiyat qozonish uchun juda muhim.

bulletPoints: Describe a time you taught a friend a technique to stay calm or reduce stress.
How did supporting someone else's mental health help you understand your own emotions better?
Why is emotional intelligence often more important for success than academic grades?
questions.sampleAnswer:
I remember a time when my friend, Sarah, was going through a particularly stressful period at work. She was constantly overwhelmed and anxious, and it was really taking a toll on her mental health. I decided to teach her a simple mindfulness technique that I had found helpful: focused breathing. I explained how to find a quiet space, close her eyes, and concentrate on the sensation of her breath entering and leaving her body. I emphasized the importance of not judging her thoughts, but simply observing them and letting them pass.

Supporting Sarah through this process helped me realize how powerful it is to actively manage my own emotions. Indeed, seeing her struggle with anxiety made me more aware of my own stress triggers and coping mechanisms. It reinforced the importance of self-care and the benefits of taking time to prioritize my mental well-being. I began to incorporate mindfulness into my daily routine, and I found that it significantly reduced my own stress levels.

Ultimately, emotional intelligence is often more crucial for success than academic grades because it enables us to build strong relationships, communicate effectively, and navigate complex social situations. While academic knowledge is important, it's our ability to understand and manage our emotions that truly allows us to thrive in both our personal and professional lives. It goes without saying that empathy, self-awareness, and the ability to regulate our emotions are essential qualities for leadership, collaboration, and overall well-being. At the end of the day, emotional intelligence allows us to connect with others on a deeper level and build meaningful relationships.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Esimda, bir paytlar do'stim Sara ishda juda stressli davrni boshidan kechirayotgan edi. U doimiy ravishda o'zini bosimsiz his qilmasdi va xavotirda edi, bu uning ruhiy salomatligiga jiddiy ta'sir qilardi. Men unga o'zimga foydali bo'lgan oddiy xotirjamlik texnikasini o'rgatishga qaror qildim: diqqatni nafasga qaratish. Men unga qanday qilib tinch joy topish, ko'zlarini yumish va nafas olish va chiqarish hissiyotiga e'tibor qaratishni tushuntirdim. Men uning fikrlarini baholamaslik, balki ularni shunchaki kuzatib, o'tib ketishiga qo'yib berish muhimligini ta'kidladim.

Saraga bu jarayonda yordam berish menga o'z his-tuyg'ularimni faol boshqarish naqadar kuchli ekanligini anglashimga yordam berdi. Haqiqatan ham, uning xavotir bilan kurashayotganini ko'rish meni o'z stress omillarim va ularga qarshi kurashish usullarimdan ko'proq xabardor qildi. Bu o'zimga g'amxo'rlik qilish va ruhiy farovonligimni birinchi o'ringa qo'yishning afzalliklari muhimligini yana bir bor tasdiqladi. Men kundalik hayotimga xotirjamlikni kiritishni boshladim va bu o'z stress darajamni sezilarli darajada kamaytirdi.

Oxir oqibat, hissiy intellekt ko'pincha akademik baholarga qaraganda muvaffaqiyat uchun muhimroqdir, chunki u bizga kuchli munosabatlar o'rnatish, samarali muloqot qilish va murakkab ijtimoiy vaziyatlarda harakat qilish imkonini beradi. Akademik bilim muhim bo'lsa-da, aynan o'z his-tuyg'ularimizni tushunish va boshqarish qobiliyatimiz bizga shaxsiy va professional hayotimizda gullab-yashnashga imkon beradi. Aytishga hojat yo'qki, hamdardlik, o'zini anglash va o'z his-tuyg'ularini tartibga solish qobiliyati yetakchilik, hamkorlik va umumiy farovonlik uchun zarur sifatlardir. Yakuniy natijada, hissiy intellekt bizga boshqalar bilan chuqurroq aloqa o'rnatish va mazmunli munosabatlar qurish imkonini beradi.

questions.prompt: Driverless Cars Should Replace Human Drivers
questions.sampleA1: Driverless cars are good. They are safe. But maybe they are bad.
questions.sampleA2: Driverless cars can be good because they are safe. But they can be hacked. It is a problem.
questions.sampleB1: Driverless cars could be good. They might reduce accidents. They could help disabled people. For example, disabled people can travel more easily. However, there are some problems. The cars could be hacked. People could lose their jobs.
questions.sampleB2: Well, this is a real double-edged sword, so let me weigh up both sides. On the one hand, the case for driverless cars is pretty strong. The vast majority of accidents are down to human error — speeding, tiredness, people glued to their phones — and machines simply don't get distracted or drive drunk. In theory, they react faster and could cut the death toll dramatically. On top of that, they'd be a real game-changer for elderly or disabled people who can't drive, giving them a newfound sense of independence. And if all the cars talk to each other, traffic jams could ease off too. On the other hand, I do have my reservations. For one thing, there's the security side — if hackers got hold of the system, the consequences could be catastrophic. Then there's the question of who's to blame when something goes wrong; sorting out the legal liability is a real headache. Insurance companies and courts would be tied up in knots for years. And let's not forget the millions of taxi and lorry drivers who'd be thrown out of work overnight. So where do I stand? To be honest, I'm cautiously optimistic. I reckon driverless cars will gradually take over, but it won't happen overnight, and it shouldn't. The technology needs to be watertight first, and governments have to iron out the rules. At the end of the day, if they genuinely save lives, I think it's a step in the right direction — we just have to tread carefully and make sure nobody gets left behind.

Biroq, xavflar mavjud. Dasturiy ta'minotni buzish baxtsiz hodisalarga olib kelishi mumkin va ko'plab haydovchilar ish joylarini yo'qotishi mumkin.
Barcha narsalarni hisobga olganda, bu masalalarni diqqat bilan hal qilish kerak.

vocabulary.title: Driverless Cars - First words of prompt...

questions.sampleAnswer:
The debate around driverless cars replacing human drivers is complex, with valid arguments on both sides. On the one hand, the potential for eliminating human error, which is a significant cause of accidents, is compelling. Driverless cars, theoretically, can react faster and more consistently than humans, potentially saving lives and reducing injuries. Additionally, the prospect of reduced traffic congestion, as cars communicate and coordinate with each other, is very appealing. It stands to reason that this would improve traffic flow and reduce commute times. Furthermore, driverless cars could offer increased mobility for disabled individuals who are unable to drive themselves, opening up new opportunities and improving their quality of life.

However, there are significant concerns that must be addressed. The risk of software hacking and potential system failures is a major worry. Indeed, a malicious attack could have devastating consequences, potentially causing widespread accidents and chaos. The potential job loss for professional drivers, such as truck drivers and taxi drivers, is another serious consideration. Every cloud has a silver lining, but in this case, the economic impact could be substantial. Finally, the issue of legal liability in the event of an accident is complex and unresolved. The ball is in the court of lawmakers to establish clear guidelines and regulations to address these concerns.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Haydovchisiz avtomobillar inson haydovchilarini almashtirishi haqidagi bahs murakkab bo'lib, har ikki tomonda ham asosli dalillar mavjud. Bir tomondan, baxtsiz hodisalarning asosiy sababi bo'lgan inson xatosini yo'q qilish potentsiali juda jozibali. Nazariy jihatdan, haydovchisiz avtomobillar insonlarga qaraganda tezroq va izchilroq reaksiyaga kirisha oladi, bu esa hayotni saqlab qolishi va jarohatlarni kamaytirishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, avtomobillar bir-biri bilan aloqa qilib, muvofiqlashtirilgani sababli, tirbandlikning kamayishi istiqboli juda yoqimli. Shuni ta'kidlash joizki, bu transport oqimini yaxshilaydi va qatnov vaqtini qisqartiradi. Bundan tashqari, haydovchisiz avtomobillar o'zlari haydashga qodir bo'lmagan nogironlarga harakatlanish imkoniyatini oshirishi, yangi imkoniyatlar yaratishi va ularning hayot sifatini yaxshilashi mumkin.

Biroq, hal qilinishi kerak bo'lgan muhim xavotirlar mavjud. Dasturiy ta'minotni buzish va tizimning ishdan chiqish xavfi katta tashvish tug'diradi. Haqiqatan ham, zararli hujum halokatli oqibatlarga olib kelishi, keng ko'lamli baxtsiz hodisalar va xaosga sabab bo'lishi mumkin. Yuk mashinalari haydovchilari va taksi haydovchilari kabi professional haydovchilarning ishsiz qolish ehtimoli yana bir jiddiy masala. Har bir yomg'ir ortidan quyosh chiqadi, lekin bu holda iqtisodiy ta'sir sezilarli bo'lishi mumkin. Nihoyat, baxtsiz hodisa yuz berganda yuridik javobgarlik masalasi murakkab va hal etilmagan. Ushbu xavotirlarni bartaraf etish uchun aniq ko'rsatmalar va qoidalarni o'rnatish qonun chiqaruvchilarning zimmasida.
